Each Aniimo has its own innate potential. After you catch and report an Aniimo, it will be rated based on its total Innate Potential and recommended attributes. Ratings are divided into 4 tiers: <color=#69b471>Common</color>, <color=#66a0e5>Good</color>, <color=#c86df8>Elite</color>, and <color=#f6a33c>Perfect</color>. A higher potential tier means stronger starting attributes, making that Aniimo a better choice to train.
